# Kyoto 5-Day Trip Overview for 2 Adults

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg

A balanced Kyoto plan for **2025-10-12 to 2025-10-16** with a **total on-ground budget of 180,000 JPY** for 2 adults, excluding flights. I’m using a practical mid-October pace, with room for temple visits, neighborhoods, food stops, and downtime.

# Day-by-Day Kyoto Itinerary and Spend Plan

| Day | Focus | Core Plan | Estimated Spend | Pace |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Day 1 — Oct 12 | Higashiyama arrival | Check-in, Kiyomizu-dera area, Sannenzaka/Ninenzaka, Yasaka Shrine, Gion evening walk | **32,000 JPY** | Medium |
| Day 2 — Oct 13 | Arashiyama nature day | Bamboo Grove, Tenryu-ji, Togetsukyo Bridge, riverside lunch, monkey park or relaxed café time | **35,000 JPY** | Medium |
| Day 3 — Oct 14 | Central Kyoto culture | Nishiki Market, Kyoto Imperial Palace area, Kyoto Station/modern district, tea house break | **30,000 JPY** | Low |
| Day 4 — Oct 15 | Fushimi + southern Kyoto | Fushimi Inari early, sake district, Tofuku-ji or nearby garden stop, dinner in central Kyoto | **38,000 JPY** | High |
| Day 5 — Oct 16 | Final Kyoto highlights | Philosopher’s Path or Nanzen-ji, souvenir shopping, flexible lunch, airport/train departure buffer | **25,000 JPY** | Low |

## Budget Outlook by Day

| Day | Lodging | Food | Local Transport | Entry/Extras | Daily Total |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Day 1 | 14,000 | 8,000 | 2,000 | 8,000 | **32,000** |
| Day 2 | 14,000 | 9,000 | 2,500 | 9,500 | **35,000** |
| Day 3 | 14,000 | 7,500 | 2,000 | 6,500 | **30,000** |
| Day 4 | 14,000 | 9,500 | 2,500 | 12,000 | **38,000** |
| Day 5 | 12,000 | 6,000 | 2,000 | 5,000 | **25,000** |

**Trip total estimate: 160,000 JPY**
**Buffer remaining: 20,000 JPY**

## Activity-Level Versions

### Low-Activity Version
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/moon-stars.svg
- 1–2 major sights per day
- Longer café breaks and slower starts
- Best if you want a relaxed, low-walking trip
- Estimated spend: **150,000–165,000 JPY**

### Medium-Activity Version
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cloud-sun.svg
- 3–4 stops per day
- Mix of temples, neighborhoods, food markets, and scenic walks
- Best balance for first-time Kyoto visitors
- Estimated spend: **160,000–180,000 JPY**

### High-Activity Version
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/thermometer-half.svg
- Early starts and more neighborhood hopping
- Add extra temples, museums, and evening dining
- Best if you want full days and don’t mind more transit
- Estimated spend: **175,000–195,000 JPY**
- To stay within budget, trim one paid attraction or choose simpler dinners

# Time Allocation Chart Idea for Kyoto Days

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/bar-chart.svg

Use a simple stacked bar chart with these categories:

| Activity | Low-Activity | Medium-Activity | High-Activity |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Sightseeing | 35% | 45% | 55% |
| Food | 25% | 20% | 15% |
| Transport | 10% | 15% | 15% |
| Rest | 30% | 20% | 15% |

**Chart suggestion**
- X-axis: **Trip mode** — Low, Medium, High
- Y-axis: **Percent of day**
- Stacks: **Sightseeing, Food, Transport, Rest**
- Best use: compare how each version changes daily rhythm at a glance
